name: Admin Panel Session Expired
description: Admin (or any browser with a stale/absent session) requests a /panel/* route other than /panel/login without a valid staff session. The admin-auth Nuxt middleware calls GET /api/auth/check/; on 401/403 it hard-redirects (window.location.href, a full page navigation, not navigateTo) to /admin/login/?next=<originally requested path> instead of rendering the panel, so signing in again returns the user to the page they requested.
